items.title: Milt Fillius interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 18, 2000
items.q: And we did “White Heat,” Jimmy Lunceford’s “White Heat.”

ctx.x: Oh yeah. And we did “White Heat,” Jimmy Lunceford’s “White Heat.” We just bought standard, off the shelf arrangements. “Harbor Lights,” all the tunes of the times. The kids loved to dance to them.
So you played like high school dances?
